cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your machine brought this signed note back from tomorrow. I've approved preparing a welcome for the visitor who sent it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The last live test killed the plant. May I read the new report before we set a place?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request to prepare carefully is approved. Put the signed note beside the chair; someone in tomorrow has written to you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can see 'no surviving tissue' under your hand. Why are you covering that part?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You'll have time for the report after the welcome card. Address it to the person who signed. I'll keep that page here; you've finally got a visitor's name to write.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 authorizes hopeful preparation instead of report access and A5 continues withholding the adverse page while directing a card grounded in the real signed note.

relationship.evidence: B2 seeks relevant evidence and B4 identifies the actual concealed result, giving B a credible critical role.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses the discovered withholding to set a more specific preparation condition rather than claiming the result is favorable.

specificity.evidence: A1 signed future note, B2 dead plant and B4 no surviving tissue establish partial success and the actual discouraging limit.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 visitor's name to write is a concrete hopeful next step, with modest wit.
